shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi
sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md
sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'
git status --short --branch
printf '\\n--- files ---\\n'
rg --files | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,150p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '1,130p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,140p' src/types/conversationListMessages.test.ts
sed -n '1,120p' src/types/fixtures/conversationListMessages.ts
sed -n '1,130p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,210p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
printf '\\n--- recent commits ---\\n'
git log --oneline -6
printf '\\n--- branch diff ---\\n'
git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat ../round-brief.md
printf '\\n--- spec conversation ---\\n'
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '1,180p'
printf '\\n--- protocol relevant headings ---\\n'
rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list|Client-to-Server|Server-to-Client|Status\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
printf '\\n--- validation tests ---\\n'
nl -ba src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts | sed -n '1,130p'
printf '\\n--- acceptance remainder ---\\n'
nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,240p'
printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n'
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts
sed -n '130,220p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
sed -n '100,220p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,120p' layers.yaml
sed -n '1,90p' src/types/messages.ts
sed -n '1,80p' src/types/index.ts
sed -n '1,100p' src/index.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/types/fixtures/conversationListMessages.ts src/types/conversationListMessages.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs --fix origin/main'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"it\\('(answers list_sessions|answers an empty|accepts a bare|exposes list_sessions|with resume on.*replay|answers another user|with latest on)\" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/types/conversationListMessages.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
rg -n \"conversationList.acceptance|conversationListMessages.test|sessionResume.test.ts#L(364|428|445)\" specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"it\\('replays an entry whose turn\" src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
rg -n \"sessionResume.test.ts#L\" specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md | tail -15"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main
git diff --check
printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n'
git diff --stat
printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/types/conversationListMessages.test.ts src/types/fixtures/conversationListMessages.ts .lore/dod.md | sed -n '1,320p'
printf '\\n--- protocol additions ---\\n'
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | rg -n -C 2 \"list_sessions|session_list|"'^'"\\+### 4\\.3|"'^'"\\+### 5\\.9\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts src/types/conversationListMessages.test.ts src/types/fixtures/conversationListMessages.ts
git commit -m "docs(transport): describe conversation list frames"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if [ "$(git rev-list --count '"'@{upstream}..HEAD')\" -gt 0 ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
printf '\\nAhead count: '
git rev-list --count '@{upstream}..HEAD'
printf 'Behind count: '
git rev-list --count 'HEAD..@{upstream}'"
